svg.text: Raven Rock Mountain Complex — Level Plans
Raven Rock Mountain Complex ("Site R"), Blue Ridge Summit, Adams County, PA — the "underground Pentagon"
Envelope 600x600 blocks, x[-300,300] z[-300,300]. North = -Z (up). All geometry: creative approximation.
Tunnel mouths in the rock face at the envelope edges.
Blast vestibules and the descending tunnel runs.
Cavern A/B floors, the rotunda, buildings on their spring pedestals.
Cavern C's reservoir sump, the deepest point in the complex.

Raven Rock's interior is CLASSIFIED (REF-015). Every coordinate shown is CREATIVE APPROXIMATION, invented for a Minecraft build. This is an openly-labelled interpretation of a public landmark, NOT a map of the real facility.
